Salzman, Attorneys, Ian Heath Gershengorn, Acting Solicitor General, Department of Justice, Washington, DC, for Petitioner., *1751Greiner, P.C., Haddonfield, NJ, for Respondent., This case concerns a dance-rock band's application for federal trademark registration of the band's name, "The Slants." "Slants" is a derogatory term for persons of Asian descent, and members of the band are Asian-Americans. But the band members believe that by taking that slur as the name of their group, they will help to "reclaim" the term and drain its denigrating force.
